#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

enum class Zone { OUT, IN };

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string z;
    std::cin >> n >> z;
    Zone zone = Zone::OUT;
    int count = 0;
    int outsideMax = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = z[i];
        if (c == '_') {
            if (zone == Zone::OUT) {
                if (count > outsideMax) outsideMax = count;
            } else {
                if (count > 0) insideWords++;
            }
            count = 0;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            zone = Zone::IN;
            if (count > outsideMax) outsideMax = count;
            count = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            zone = Zone::OUT;
            if (count > 0) insideWords++;
            count = 0;
        } else {
            count++;
        }
    }
    if (zone == Zone::OUT && count > outsideMax) outsideMax = count;
    std::cout << outsideMax << " " << insideWords << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
